shops.title: Shops
shops.description: Shopify storefront origins: full URLs (https://www.allbirds.com) or bare domains (gymshark.com). Path suffixes are ignored.

collections.title: Collection handles
collections.description: If non-empty, fetch only these collection product lists (/{handle}/products.json) instead of the whole catalog. Applied to every shop.

maxProductsPerShop.title: Max products per shop
maxProductsPerShop.description: Cap per shop (pagination uses 250/page). Default 40 keeps empty-input runs under a few minutes.

onlyChangedSince.title: Only changed since (ISO)
onlyChangedSince.description: If set (e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z), keep only products whose updated_at is strictly after this timestamp. Empty = all.
